Class TT_Header

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<TT_Header>
org.lwjgl.util.freetype.TT_Header
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pointer
public class TT_Header extends Struct<TT_Header>
struct TT_Header {
    FT_Fixed Table_Version;
    FT_Fixed Font_Revision;
    FT_Long CheckSum_Adjust;
    FT_Long Magic_Number;
    FT_UShort Flags;
    FT_UShort Units_Per_EM;
    FT_ULong Created[2];
    FT_ULong Modified[2];
    FT_Short xMin;
    FT_Short yMin;
    FT_Short xMax;
    FT_Short yMax;
    FT_UShort Mac_Style;
    FT_UShort Lowest_Rec_PPEM;
    FT_Short Font_Direction;
    FT_Short Index_To_Loc_Format;
    FT_Short Glyph_Data_Format;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • TT_Header

      public TT_Header(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a TT_Header instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
